messages:
Alex J: Quick follow-up from the metering postmortem — we need a concrete plan for token-delta audits and a customer crediting playbook. I shelved a spreadsheet here: https://redwood.example.com/sheets/token-delta-audit (please request access if you don't have it).

Cheng W: Tagged. Can you summarize the immediate actions?

Alex J: Sure — high level: 1) daily delta job to surface delayed ingestion > 1 hour, 2) automated invoice hold for affected customers until we reconcile, 3) script to compute token deltas per-customer with audit trail, 4) owner + ETA for manual crediting and support comms.

Priya M: For (1) when you say \"delta job\" — is that a re-run of the ingestion pipeline or a separate aggregator?

Alex J: Separate aggregator. Plan is: query the raw usage stream, compare to billing ingestion table, emit rows where ingestion_timestamp - event_timestamp > 3600s or where token_count differs by >1%.

Sam R: I'll own the aggregator job and glue it into our alerts. ETA end of week (Fri EOD).

Cheng W: I'll own the compute script for token deltas and the safety checks. Will add a signed CSV export for ledger team. ETA Thu.

Alex J: Cool. Priya, can you put together the invoice-hold flow & support template? Need legal/CC approval for credits. ETA next Tue?

Priya M: Yes, I'll draft the template and the runbook. Will ping Legal for approval and post the doc in the spreadsheet.

BillingBot: [automated] New issue created: MET-4232 - \"Delayed ingestion > 1h: delta audit\" assigned to Sam R. Link: https://redwood.example.com/issues/MET-4232

Sam R: Quick note on SLOs — we should only auto-hold invoices if projected delta > $50 or >2% of monthly bill to avoid overblocking small customers. Thoughts?

Cheng W: Agreed. Let's parameterize thresholds in the aggregator config. Default: $100 or 3% of monthly usage.

Alex J: Sounds reasonable. We'll keep the threshold configurable per-customer (tiers). Add a GDPR flag to exclude PII exports.

Priya M: For customer comms: suggested wording in draft sheet: \"We detected delayed usage ingestion affecting your invoice; we are reconciling and will issue corrections/credits within X business days.\" Need legal to confirm X (currently set to 7).

Cheng W: On the compute side, here's the core SQL I'll use (placeholder):

```
SELECT customer_id,
       SUM(raw.tokens) AS raw_tokens,
       SUM(bill.tokens) AS ingested_tokens,
       SUM(raw.tokens)-SUM(bill.tokens) AS token_delta,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(bill.ingest_ts) - MAX(raw.event_ts)) AS max_delay_secs
FROM raw_usage raw
LEFT JOIN billing_ingest bill
  ON raw.event_id = bill.event_id
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING token_delta != 0 OR max_delay_secs > 3600;
```

Sam R: Nice. Make sure we keep event_id joins optional — there are some legacy events that don't have mapping. We'll fall back to windowed match by user+time.

Alex J: Let's capture these action items in the sheet under the \"Remediation\" tab and tag owners. I added an initial table; please update with start/end dates and blockers.

Priya M: One more ask — sync to support: if we issue credits, we need to send a proactive email + support ticket with reason code \"metering-delay-credit\". I'll make the support automation rule.

Sam R: I'll add a small CLI utility to generate the credits CSV using the signed export from Cheng. Usage: `./gen_credits --since 2026-03-01 --threshold 100`

Alex J: Good. Also want to track recurring patterns: daily spikes around 03:00 UTC where ingestion lag increases. Can we add a Grafana panel to the incidents dashboard to show token_delta_by_hour?

Cheng W: On it. I'll create the panel and add an annotation for MET-4232.

BillingBot: [automated] MET-4232 status updated: in_progress -> review (Sam R).

Priya M: Legal responded — 7 business days OK for customer notice, but credits should be visible on the next invoice cycle if processed by finance. Noted.

Alex J: Ownership summary: Sam R: aggregator job + credit CLI; Cheng W: delta compute + signed export + Grafana panel; Priya M: invoice-hold flow + support automation + comms; Alex J: PM owner for rollout and liaison to Legal/Finance. Timeline: Cheng Thu, Sam Fri, Priya Tue next week.

Sam R: I'll open a PR for the aggregator and link it in the sheet.

Cheng W: PR for compute script coming in ~3 hours.

Priya M: Draft support email uploaded to the sheet. Please review.

Alex J: Great work — let's do a quick sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to confirm Legal sign-off and that the aggregator/PRs are green. If anything slips, we escalate to Finance lead for manual holds.

Sam R: 👍

Cheng W: 👍

Priya M: 👍

BillingBot: [automated] Reminder: MET-4232 in_progress assigned to Sam R will auto-escalate in 72 hours if no PR linked.
